subject: general
question: The curved surface of a right circular cylinder is to be coloured at the rate of ₹1.50 per sq. cm. If the radius of the circular base is 21 cm and height is 10 cm, then what will be the cost (in ₹) of colouring? (Use pi = frac{22}7)
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of colouring = ₹1.50 per sq. cm

Radius of circ
ular base = 21 cm

Height of cylinder = 10 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = 2 × π × radius × height

Total cost = CSA × Rate per sq. cm

**Calculation:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r × h

⇒ CSA = 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 10

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 3 × 10

⇒ CSA = 1320 sq. cm

Total cost = CSA × Rate

⇒ Total cost = 1320 × 1.50

⇒ Total cost = ₹1980

**The cost of colouring the curved surface of the cylinder is ₹1980.**
